Loan 2025-0917-001 has been assigned a disposition of NEEDS_REVIEW. This means the loan did not clear automated QC and requires human examination before it can proceed. The disposition was triggered by three distinct review reasons: EXCEPTION, APPLICABILITY_UNKNOWN, and UNSPECIFIED_THRESHOLD. Each is addressed separately below.

EXCEPTION: There are 1,643 checks that failed outright as hard exceptions. The sample illustrates the kinds of defects found. Check 1031-exchange-proceeds-documented failed because 1031 exchange proceeds were not documented and verified. Check 1099-income-avg-correct failed because 1099 income was not averaged correctly using the documented history and applicable expense reduction. Check 1099-income-doc-complete failed because the 1099 income documentation is incomplete, with the file missing one or more required items such as two years of 1099s, year-to-date paystubs or equivalent, and pages one and two of tax returns. No Guide section is attached to any of these facts yet, as the guide citation lookup contains no entries for this loan.

APPLICABILITY_UNKNOWN: There are 924 checks that could not be evaluated because required precondition fields are missing from the loan data. For example, check ace-appraisal-adu-rental-income could not run because the field income_type_used_for_qualification is unknown. Check ace-eligibility-requirements-met and check ace-pdr-appraisal-required-by-law both could not run because the field loan_collateral_advisor_relief_type is unknown. Until these upstream data gaps are resolved, it is impossible to determine whether these checks would pass or fail. No Guide section is attached to these facts yet.

UNSPECIFIED_THRESHOLD: There are 79 checks that could not execute because the numeric threshold required to evaluate the rule was never defined in the source rule text and requires subject-matter expert input. The sample includes check arm-sofr-5-6-qualifying-rate-floor, check buydown-rate-points-too-high, and check choicereno-express-max-financed-reno-costs-exceeded, all of which are blocked for this reason. No Guide section is attached to these facts yet.

In addition to the sample shown above, there are also 8 checks flagged as UNLABELED in the category counts, and the sample includes two NEEDS_REVIEW items without a review reason tag: check employment-dates-1003-vs-docs-agree and check gla-calculation-consistency and check gla-room-count-consistency, each of which found a document value but had no system value to compare it against.

Across all three review-reason categories, the run produced 2,654 total exceptions and needs-review checks out of 3,203 checks run, and 2642 more checks not individually listed here. The loan requires comprehensive underwriter and data-quality review before any disposition change is possible.
